Buzhou mountain effects and stage presentation.

Buzhou has three locked-per-run routes (Tầm bảo, Chiêu hiền, Đoạt khí), max five free assigned generals, commander-first ordering, per-hero artifact selection, six daily entries and up to five purchased entries. Loss/draw withdraws the party; a run resets to floor 1. Floors can be fought only in order, in groups of five defenders; casualties carry across waves. UI shows one floor book, one capture, or equipment rates according to route.
